title: Hildegard of Bingen
summary: Born in 1098 at Bermersheim in the diocese of Mainz, Hildegard founded her own convent at Rupertsberg in 1150, according to one source with 18 nuns. Her visionary work Scivias was composed c. 1142–1151. She died on 17 September 1179. The pin marks her Rupertsberg convent site, now in Bingen am Rhein.

uncertainty.note: Years as given by the opened sources; one source writes c. 1150 for the Rupertsberg founding.

as_recorded.value: In 1150, Hildegard founded her own convent at Rupertsberg.

importance.justification: Founded the Rupertsberg convent and composed the visionary work Scivias and later works (Ordo Virtutum, 1151).
